description: This file is an index module that re-exports various functions, API clients, configuration helpers, React hooks, and UI components from different files in a JavaScript/React project related to a Wi-Fi testing management platform. It acts as an entry point to expose a set of functionalities to other parts of the application.

methods.name: createApiClient
methods.description: Factory function to create an API client instance for backend communication.

methods.name: getDefaultApiConfig
methods.description: Returns the default configuration for the API client.

methods.name: getRuntimeApiMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current runtime mode of the API.

methods.name: setRuntimeApiMode
methods.description: Sets the runtime mode for the API.

methods.name: clearRuntimeApiMode
methods.description: Clears the current runtime API mode.

methods.name: notifyApiError
methods.description: Handles and displays API error notifications.
